final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS difference FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(difference) AS mean_difference FROM step1) SELECT SUM(step1.difference), AVG(step1.difference - step2.mean_difference) FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.mean_difference IS NOT NULL AND step1.difference > step2.mean_difference
